findings.summary: The least-privilege remediation does not fully close SEC-G2-004. The bound permissions manifest authorizes github:create-item-commit for any path with the literal prefix intent/0001/, so its declared oracle allows the same action for intent/0001/BRIEF.md, intent/0001/EXAM.md, and intent/0001/signatures/gate-2.json. The manifest has no separate Exam-author assignment selector and no required denial for protected Exam, signature, review, or policy paths. Because the bound rollout identifies this GitHub App actor as the allowlisted Test Agent, actor-bound Exam CI cannot distinguish an independently assigned Exam-author operation from an ordinary application-originated commit made with that App. The validator tests selector syntax and mapping completeness but contains no protected-path negative fixture. The target therefore does not deterministically prove that a Builder, originator flow, platform process, or compromised caller cannot use the App action to author protected work or bypass the intended separation before a code-host write.
findings.requiredResolution: Replace the catch-all item path prefix with action-specific exact paths or closed path classes and explicit protected-path denials. A normal item-create action must deny EXAM, signature, review, policy, and other governance paths before installation-token exchange or code-host write. If App-authored Exam candidates remain supported, define a distinct Exam-author action that requires independently verified current Test Agent assignment, exact Exam path and target, and the actor-bound review path. The approval-record action must likewise require the exact signature path plus a current verified-human decision envelope and eligibility context. Add validator fixtures showing ordinary item, retry, fallback, originator, Builder, platform-agent, worker, and compromised-caller requests cannot target protected paths, and that CI actor allowlisting alone cannot convert such a request into authorized Exam authorship. Refresh every affected digest and obtain a new exact-revision review.

escalations.reason: SEC-G2-R2-001 leaves a major least-privilege and protected-authorship gap in the Exam oracle. The commercial default-closed policy requires human Security specialist escalation unless the Exam and bound permission oracle are revised and a new exact-revision review confirms closure; this agent cannot waive or accept the gap.
